provenance.coverage: Two new TypeScript modules: 7 conflict, 4 enqueue and 9 replay behavior checks.
provenance.derivation: Real merged PR #365 at its exact base: the historical M6.3 briefing as the instruction, with an explicit contract section added so hidden checks are deterministic; base files are empty stubs; the reference is the merged pair of modules. Hidden scenarios re-express the PR's 21 vitest cases (plus enqueue-failure propagation) as fake-fs/GitHub observations; assertions stay on the trusted host. v2 (MB-010c follow-up): native admission found the instruction's 'never double-apply' contradicts the merged oracle, which keeps a saved entry queued when cleanup fails and may re-save it. The oracle is the real merged code, so only the instruction changed: it now states no-loss, at-least-once delivery with the cleanup-failure re-save explicitly allowed. No hidden check requires exactly-once on that path. v3: literal-overspecification audit (MB-010r-literal-audit.json, sha256 73c2e9f82e51fffa99fb102c6f2c711252404dbcdee093f8d608df2586484412): queue id 'filesystem-safe' checked as /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ -> rejects only path separators, reserved, whitespace and control characters and '.'/'..'. Instruction and oracle unchanged. v4 (round 3): native round-3 admission of v3 returned needs_fix (receipt benchmarks/michael/curriculum/MBR3-kerrigan-plan-conflict-queue-v3-admission.json, sha256 f76141d9074491a1e14c7a28ef8b8920bfc92fedecfd2f7805882113e222e022): the Goal said the plan-edit PR must come from the agent:go issue, while merged #365 (the oracle) and the checks only require that a labeled issue and a plan-edit PR both be open. The Goal and Contract now state that no association is required, matching #365; a Grading note states that the module comment, strict-TS style and the default queue directory are plan requirements that are not graded. Oracle and hidden checks unchanged. Self-audit against the v3 receipt's untested requirements: enqueue mkdir and rename failure propagation, unreadable (readFile-failing) entries and non-empty error messages are now checked; the module comment, strict TS/import-type rule, FsLike typing and default directory are declared ungraded.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
